connector.name: Microsoft 365 Teams
connector.registryDescription: Microsoft 365 Teams via Graph: list chats, read/send messages, list teams/channels, presence.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-server-microsoft-teams. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the mindstone account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: MS_ACCOUNT_EMAIL
env.description: Account email when running in multi-account per-instance mode (falls back to the first account in accounts.json)

env.name: MS_MCP_PACKAGE_ID
env.description: Logical package ID surfaced in error responses

env.name: MICROSOFT_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS
env.description: Override the upstream Microsoft Graph request timeout in milliseconds (max 300000 = 5 min)
